subject: Follow-up: LatticeGrid discovery — pilot charter, eval metrics, and access
messages:
From: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@latticegrid.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: LatticeGrid discovery — pilot charter, eval metrics, and access

Alex — thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of pain & goals (from our call)
- Primary pain: poor document search relevance for regulatory docs (high false negatives).
- Secondary: cost to serve large retrieval requests and bursty inference during audits.
- LatticeGrid goal: reduce relevant-miss rate on compliance queries by 40% and hold average query latency <150ms for 95th percentile in production-like load.

Proposed pilot scope (30 days)
1) Dataset: 200k doc subset you flagged (contracts + regulatory appendices) for prompt/eval development.
2) Workloads: small-batch retrieval + reranking path; 5k daily query mix during sprint; one scheduled 20k query stress run in week 3.
3) Success metrics: relevance uplift on held-out test by relative improvement (R@10) target + latency P95 < 150ms and cost/unit estimate.

Owners and roles
- Redwood (we): sergio — program lead; marissa — prompt/eval authoring and monitoring; ben — infra/observability and access liaison.
- LatticeGrid: Alex — PM; Jill — infra/security owner; you'll nominate a data owner for the doc subset.

Access & timeline
- Action 1 (this week): Alex, share S3 paths or sample dump (s3://latticegrid/pilot-samples) and confirm data owner contact by Thu 4/15.
- Action 2 (week 1): Redwood to provision a private sandbox (VPC peering + minimal IAM) — we'll send the network checklist attached.
- Action 3 (week 1–2): prompt/eval matrix draft from Marissa + baseline eval run.
- Action 4 (week 3): stress run and cost review; week 4: joint readout and next-steps decision.

Attachments: pilot charter v1, eval metrics template, network access checklist.

Next steps from Redwood: we will provision the sandbox and send the NDA redline (if any) by EOD Tue. Can you confirm your data owner's email and if SOC2 evidence will be required to start the sandbox?

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: latticegrid-pilot-charter-v1.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: eval-metrics-proposal.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: network-access-checklist.txt (txt)]

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@latticegrid.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jill Tanaka <jill.tanaka@latticegrid.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: LatticeGrid discovery — pilot charter, eval metrics, and access

Sergio — appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications and commitments below.

Clarifications:
- Data: we can provide a 220k doc S3 prefix (s3://latticegrid/pilot-220k) containing the contract corpus and a labeled set of 4k queries with relevance judgments (CSV).
- Security: Jill will coordinate SOC2 scoping. We don't need a full SOC2 report to start the sandbox, but we will require encryption-at-rest, IAM b/w accounts, and access logs forwarded to our SIEM.
- Latency: 150ms P95 is aggressive but reasonable as a joint target for the reranker path — baseline currently ~420ms P95.

Commitments / next steps (from LatticeGrid):
- Action A: I'll share the S3 prefix and an IAM role for read-only access by EOD Thu 4/15.
- Action B: Jill <jill.tanaka@latticegrid.ai> will respond with the list of required compliance artifacts and any VPN specs by Fri 4/16.
- Action C: We'll provide a small sample (5k docs) earlier if Redwood wants to start model prompt tuning right away.

We agree to the owners you listed. Also please include a lightweight cost-estimate for the proposed stress run (we want to budget proactively).

Thanks — Alex
Alex Rivera
Head of Product
LatticeGrid

Subject: Re: Follow-up: LatticeGrid discovery — pilot charter, eval metrics, and access

Alex / Jill — looping in a quick plan for the eval workflow so you have visibility on timing and deliverables.

Week 0 (pre-provisioning)
- Redwood to receive S3 path + sample and confirm data schema.
- Marissa to draft prompt matrix and baseline eval tests (relevant/irrelevant pairs, R@k, MRR).

Week 1
- Baseline run on a small sample (5k docs) to establish current V0 numbers.
- Deliverable: baseline results + prompt candidates (doc + short testing notebook).

Week 2
- Iterate on prompt templates and reranker settings.
- Deliverable: candidate prompt set + batch eval and cost projection (attached xlsx will be filled).

Week 3
- Stress run and production-like scenario (20k burst).
- Deliverable: stress-run telemetry, latency P95, and unit cost estimate.

Owners: I'll lead the prompt/eval artifacts; Ben will share the observability dashboard link and runbook for the stress test.

One ask for LatticeGrid: can your S3 prefix include a sample mapping file (doc_id -> creation_date -> sensitivity_tag)? That will help define redaction/labeling boundaries.

I'll update the drive folder after the baseline completes.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: eval-metrics-proposal.xlsx (xlsx)]

Date: Fri, 15 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: LatticeGrid discovery — pilot charter, eval metrics, and access

Thanks — quick confirmations from security side: 

- We'll provision an IAM role with read-only access scoped to s3://latticegrid/pilot-220k by Thu 4/15 (you should receive cross-account role ARN).
- We require VPC peering + private endpoints; Ben, please send your network checklist and CIDR ranges.
- SOC artifacts: we'll share SOC2 Type II summary and our last penetration test report in the drive link you provided; full SOC2 report can be provided under NDA if necessary.

Notes on data labels: we can include sensitivity_tag in the mapping file but need a small glossary from you for label interpretation (PII vs regulated-clauses).

Looking forward to the baseline run next week.

Jill
Jill Tanaka
Head of Security & Compliance
LatticeGrid
